headline: Towns' 30 and 13 make it five straight
dek: Karl-Anthony Towns had 30 points and 13 rebounds, and the Knicks won their fifth straight.
three: 9 of 14 from the field and 4 of 4 from three; late in the third he outscored Indiana 10–2 by himself.
Knicks up 4 at the half, then won the third quarter 34–27
Towns and Brunson combined for 52 of 113.
Won it from three and on the glass
Threes made 15–6; assists 30–20. New York made 15 threes to Indiana’s 6.
